title: Where the backup lives: offsite, immutable and behind another credential

videos.script: Every backup in this course has lived on the same machine as the database. One disk, one fire or one stolen password takes both. {{same}} The old rule says three copies, on two kinds of storage, one of them somewhere else. {{rule}} In this lesson the shop gets a second repository, encrypted and kept longer. {{repo2}} Then you delete the first repository on purpose, and restore from the second. {{lose}} You try the passphrase wrong by one character, and watch every byte become useless. {{key}} You make a backup that even root cannot delete. And then root undoes it in one command. {{immutable}} Which leaves the real question of this lesson. Not where the copy is, but who can delete it. {{who}}
